name: Shakti back-and-forth: hippocampal signal left, then right
origin: Todd Murphy (Shakti software), after Persinger's vectorial hemisphericity theory
summary: Murphy's back-and-forth session with the hippocampal 'LTP' signal: 30 min over the left temporal lobe, its 'usually wrong' side, then 30 min over the right. Murphy says the first phase is expected to be unpleasant and the second pleasant. For the hippocampus he gives the procedure in one sentence, 'The same principle applies to the hippocampus', and no report.
setting: Advanced users only, after a side test has shown the usual pattern for the signal (this file assumes the usual sides). The vendor says darkness and silence (sensory deprivation) help; eyes closed, relaxed. Run murphy-shakti-test-session-hippocampus first.
schedule: Vendor rules: never on consecutive days, at most every 72 hours or weekly; 60-minute sessions at most once in 3 weeks.
notes: 'Alternative procedures' works the procedure out for the amygdala and adds only 'The same principle applies to the hippocampus', with no report. It gives 30 min for the wrong side and no length for phase 2: its 30 min is the project's choice. Played here: four coils over one temporal lobe per phase (FT7, C5, TP7, T9, then FT8, C6, TP8, T10), two pairs of one (+) and one (-) coil as the vendor wires its 8-coil unit; the vendor's own single-signal procedure uses a two-coil 'mono headset'. The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). It is rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's file is not published. 4 s of silence follows each train. Field strength: the vendor's 10 to 50 mG are gaussmeter readings at a coil (FAQ). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 56 uT at the coil face, 11 to 56 times the vendor's level. The left/right rule rests on user reports and on Persinger, Richards & Koren 1994: right-side fields were rated +1.2 for pleasantness, left-side ones +0.1, sham +0.9 (10 per group, p.3 [193]). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 is 'EXPECTED to be unpleasant'; if it feels good, the vendor suspects a 'reversed' structure. If it gets too uncomfortable, press Skip to start phase 2. Never stop after phase 1: the vendor says the wrong side must always be followed by the correct side. The vendor's 'undo' rules are written for amygdala-only and two-signal sessions. With headache or pressure (about 2% with hippocampal signals), lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy, seizure history or a psychiatric condition; stop if distress continues in phase 2.
